sloka: तौ परस्परमभ्येत्य सर्वगात्रेषु धन्विनौ।घोरैर्विव्यधतुर्बाणैः कृतभावावुभौ जये ।। ६.९१.३८ ।।
transliteration: tau parasparamabhyetya sarvagātreṣu dhanvinau।ghorairvivyadhaturbāṇaiḥ kṛtabhāvāvubhau jaye ।। 6.91.38 ।।

translations.english: Then smeared with blood the two, Lakshmana and Indrajit, shone like fully blossomed Kimsuka in battle.
